item.title: Trump orders US agencies to stop using Anthropic technology in clash over AI safety
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The Trump administration on Friday ordered all U.S. agencies to stop using Anthropic’s artificial intelligence technology and imposed other major penalties, escalating an unusually public clash between the government and the company over AI safety. President Donald Trump, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and other officials took to social media to chastise Anthropic [...]

item.title: Legendary singer Neil Sedaka dies at 86
item.description: Legendary singer Neil Sedaka, whose career spanned over six decades with hits like “Breaking Up Is Hard to Do” and “Laughter in the Rain,” has died at age 86, according to a statement posted on his Instagram page.

item.title: Local art shop in Holland closes after 25 years
item.description: A storewide closing sale started Friday at Lake Effect Gallery in Holland before its final day open on April 25.

item.title: Kalamazoo nonprofit bringing Black and Brown businesswomen together
item.description: A Kalamazoo-based organization is providing resources and opportunities for Black and Brown women in the world of entrepreneurship.

item.title: Detained immigrant denies ICE suggestion he's a criminal
item.description: The case of a Venezuelan man living in Michigan and the East Grand Rapids woman who helped secure his release from ICE detention on a $50,000 bond is bringing awareness to what immigration attorneys and activists have called increasingly aggressive actions by ICE and President Donald Trump's administration.

item.title: Brewery, food truck garden coming to Grand Rapids
item.description: As one business moves out of its Grand Rapids spot, the plan is to bring in a brewery and new food truck garden.

item.title: Zeeland Twp. man convicted of killing girlfriend, 63
item.description: Randall Grinwis, 59, was found guilty of open murder and larceny from $1,000 through $20,000 Friday after a three-day-long trial, Ottawa County Circuit Court records show.

item.title: Chief praises use of police dog before deadly shooting
item.description: Outgoing Grand Rapids Police Chief Eric Winstrom said he believes the police dog that took down Da'Quain Johnson last week kept him from shooting one of his officers.

item.title: Police: Teen grazed by bullet in Grand Rapids shooting
item.description: A 14-year-old boy was grazed by a gunshot in Grand Rapids Friday night, police say.

item.title: Grand Rapids man charged for doxing officer online
item.description: A man who police say wrongfully identified a Grand Rapids Police officer involved in a recent deadly shooting in the city has been charged with two felonies.
